This page is also available as Markdown . Copy On this page English TOKYO GAMES TOKEN（TGT） TOKYO GAMES TOKEN (TGT) is an in-game token (crypto asset) issued by "play3 Ltd.". Token name TOKYO GAMES TOKEN Ticker Symbol TGT Maximum Number of Issuance 1,000,000,000 Token Issuer play3 Ltd. Chain Immutable zkEVM Contract Address Immutable zkEVM 0x0FA1d8Ffa9B414ABF0F47183e088bddC32e084F3 BSC 0x6c58E4a513D3A8062E57f41a1442e003aF14eBb5 The Future Realized by TGT Move up to the Next Stage "Web3×AAA Game" Web3 games to date have created new experiences as games, such as token economics and the concept of "Play to Earn." However, any game titles have not achieved sustained success yet. This is because most of the existing Web3 games miss the element of "genuinely fun to play," which we believe the most important aspect of games. It is the "high quality games" that people need in the current Web3 gaming field. As the only platform full of "genuinely fun AAA games made in Japan," play3 Ltd. will bring Web3 games to the next stage. We will realize sustainable token economics by collecting games of all genres on its own chain and converting the passion of game fans of all types into value. What is "TGT"? TGT is the token in the area of "Web3 × AAA Games; With this token, we will target all the games players and create a completely brand new token economics which we never had. TGT is utilized as a common token to attract and develop multiple AAA games. Multiple high quality game products enable us to realize expansion of token economics and risk diversification. TGT is a common token which we can use for all games and products deployed on a proprietary chain. Not only does it expand its token economics, but it also increases the variety and depth of the user experience by crossing multiple games. Utilities of TGT The following utilities are planned for TGT. Utilities Details Common Currency Holders can use TGT as a payment currency in blockchain games on the platform. Staking By holding TGT, holders can get on-chain items which can be used for each game title on the platform. Voting TGT is used for user voting, including governance and betting functions.
